evidence.arcticAqua: Designer preferred Tint and levels over Automatic's Hue/selective color result. Active D preview, native adjustments and material measurements were inspected read-only.
evidence.gardeniaWhite: Designer reported washed-out D highlights, flat C lighting and a poor B result. This failed comparison was not captured; Gardenia reference was no longer open at inspection.

behavior.darkToLight: Prefer D for measured source L* <=50, target L* >=60 and increase >=20, subject to fabric-preservation checks
behavior.nearWhite: L* >=90, or L* >=85 and chroma <=12; conservative D seed plus local highlight-detail checks
behavior.nearWhiteFallback: C before B only when preservation checks pass; a flat C result is not accepted merely for a closer average color

activation: Build and registered development files are updated. Finish/save the active review before reloading 0.6.12; the existing session was preserved.
limitations: Provisional designer-feedback rules and tests do not prove Gardenia White is visually resolved. Validate white-fabric highlights and fallback lighting on subsequent reviewed cases.
